NEW TODAY (Week 12): Creative Arts – we compose own artworks using available performing arts instruments, resources and methods to represent performing artworks that reflect the history and way of life of people in other communities in Ghana Learners are to
Introduce tools/materials and safety rules for handling them.
main: ACTIVITY 1 (Demonstration – 5 min): Teacher models the skill using pupils' own bodies and voice – compose own artworks using available performing arts instruments, resources and methods to represent performing artworks that reflect the history and way of life of people in other communities in Ghana Learners are to
ACTIVITY 2 (Guided Practice – 5 min): Pupils practise in pairs/small groups; teacher moves round scaffolding technique and safe use of tools.
ACTIVITY 3 (Creative Making – 7 min): Pupils make individual pieces and hold a gallery walk on the lesson's theme (b2.2.2).
ACTIVITY 4 (Showcase – 3 min): Mini gallery walk / performance; peer appreciation with 'two stars and a wish'; teacher feedback on creativity and craftsmanship.
plenary: Clean-up song – pupils tidy tools and materials together.
Reflection questions: 'What did you enjoy? What was challenging? What will you try differently?'
Homework: finish or practise today's artwork/song/dance at home with family.
Preview next Visual/Performing Arts lesson.
assessment: Class exercises; oral questions; practical task; SBA
